title: "Exploded View" Assembly
build_command: docker run --rm -u 1000:1000 -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work --entrypoint sh louislam/uptime-kuma:2 -c 'npm ci && npm run build'

checks.browser: Chromium via playwright-core, against production dist at the required URL subpath

interaction_checks.name: Desktop viewport and no horizontal overflow
Final layout reassembles in a different configuration
Mobile viewport and no horizontal overflow
Mobile navigation opens and follows link
Mobile final assembly stays in viewport
Reduced motion preference loads without errors

checks.visual_review: Desktop and mobile hero, exploded and final assembly states, features, and details reviewed; cropping and callout overlaps corrected.

asset_issues.issue: Reference preview absent at the specified path.
asset_issues.resolution: Implemented the full written prompt with original DOM/CSS/SVG product artwork. No other design was read and no screenshot was used as page content.

notes: Pinned product separates into six independent components, then locks into a wider final layout. Scroll reverses the sequence.
Responsive chapter navigation, presets, power, texture/tone/space controls, mobile navigation, accordions and replay are functional.
All six font files and license notices are local; there are no external runtime asset dependencies. Font downloads recovered successfully through curl.
Reduced-motion preference uses discrete assembly states.
MONO is a fictional product concept; controls change the mockup visually and do not synthesize audio.
Validation covers the requested Chromium viewports; no claim of physical-device or cross-browser testing.
No deployment, push, agents, other sessions, or messages. ready means available for review, not published.
